newsitem.title: USA: Resource says Walsh may take reserves.
newsitem.headline: Resource says Walsh may take reserves.

text.p: Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group Inc on Tuesday said Walsh Holding Co Inc, which it has agreed to acquire, may have to restate its financial results for the year ended December 31, 1996.
In a joint statement, the companies said Walsh is investigating reports that allege its subsidiary purchased mortgage loans in transactions that stated inflated purchase prices.
The statement continued: "Upon completion of its review, Walsh will take all appropriate reserves and restate its financial statements, if necessary."
If loans closed during the 1996 calendar year prove fraudulent, the companies said, "it may be necessary for Walsh to restate its financial statements for the year."
Resource Bancshares, which on April 18 agreed to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Walsh, said it will take no action with respect to the proposed merger at this time.
